excerpt: Part history lesson, part how-to guide, part manifesto: a clear-eyed case for why tech workers organize, and how they do it.
summary: Ethan Marcotte, the designer who coined responsive web design, turns to the resurgent labor movement inside the tech industry. Drawing on extensive research and interviews with workers who have built unions at real companies, the book works as a history lesson, a practical how-to guide, and a manifesto in one. It argues that the people whose work built the industry deserve a real voice in how it runs, and it walks through what organizing actually looks like in practice.
title: You Deserve a Tech Union
